title: Lou
features:
Aimbot & Rage Bot

Master Aimbot (Keybind)
Target AI / Target Players
Aimbot Modes: Lock, Silent, Perfect Silent
Rage Bot (Auto Silent & Auto Fire)
Target Specific Body Parts
Smoothness & Hit Chance Configuration
FOV Circle (Adjustable Radius, Thickness, Color)
Dynamic FOV / FOV Only
Combat Enhancements

Prediction
Instant Hit (Hit targets instantly across map)
Backtrack (Hit past positions)
Freeze Target (Players)
Wall Check / Team Check / Sticky Aim
Auto Shoot
No Recoil / No Spread
Instant Equip
Bullet Tracers (Custom Colors & Textures)
Custom Hit Sounds & Hitmarkers

Visuals & ESP

Player ESP (Name, Health, Distance, Skeleton, Box, Active Weapon)
World ESP (Dropped Items, Corpses, Containers, Exits, Quests, Vehicles)
AI ESP (Name Tags, Highlight)
OOF Arrows (Directional off-screen indicators)
Snaplines & Aimbot Tracers
Chams (Always show or visible only)
X-Ray
World & Environment

Third Person & Custom Zoom (FOV Override)
Custom Viewmodel (Move arms X/Y/Z, Transparency, Color)
Time & Sky Presets (Custom time of day, clouds, ambient colors, RGB ambient)
Map Cleanup: No Grass, No Leaves, No Fog, No Landmines, Full Brightness
Movement & Exploits

Speed Hack & Silent Speed Hack (Bypass anticheat)
Infinity Jump & Bunny Hop
Omni Sprint
No Fall Damage
TP Kill (Teleport to kill)
Anti-Aim (Spinbot, Yaw changer, Flip)
Utility & Quality of Life

Session Stats (Kills, KD, Accuracy Tracker)
Inventory Checker (View player/corpse inventories and total value)
Player Stats Checker (View account age and K/D of targets)
Boss Information UI
Item Finder (Whitelist rare items)
Skin Changer (Weapon skins & Karambit swap)
Detector: Mod/Admin Detector, Cheater Detector
Food & Water Warning Indicator
Removals: Visor, Gas Mask Sound, Flashbangs, Screen Shake, Inventory/Repair Blur
Hide Name in Chat & Hide Server Info
NPC Teleport
Friends System (Middle click to friend)
Config Save/Load Manager
Server Browser (Filter lobbies by Map, Rank, Time, Players, and Hop)
